profile_summary: Third-year B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning with a strong foundation in Python, deep learning, and LLM engineering. Experienced in building real-world software — from automation tools used daily by hundreds of college students to RAG pipelines and transformer models built from scratch. Passionate about solving genuine problems through AI, with a track record of shipping impactful products and leading technical communities. Actively seeking internship opportunities to apply and expand skills in AI/ML engineering.

education.institution: Vidya Academy of Science and Technology

certifications: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Specialization — Andrew Ng (DeepLearning.AI)

projects.name: Feedback Automator — OnDot
description: Co-developed a browser automation tool actively used by students at Vidya Academy that completes semester feedback forms in under 15 seconds, down from 10–15 minutes manually.
Designed the full UI/UX, improving accessibility and ease of use for non-technical users.
Built a custom rating-selection feature letting users assign individual ratings per faculty member, replacing a rigid one-click default.
Adopted by a significant share of the college student body — proven real-world impact at scale.

projects.name: Attendance Monitoring Page — OnDot App
description: Contributed a key attendance overview feature to an internally built college app, replacing the need to navigate the college's slow official portal.
Displays subject-wise marked attendance at a glance; actively relied upon daily by a large share of the student body.

projects.name: GPT Language Model from Scratch
description: Implemented a character-level GPT from first principles following Andrej Karpathy's curriculum — built multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, feed-forward layers, and layer normalisation entirely in PyTorch.
Trained on a text corpus and generated coherent output, validating a complete end-to-end autoregressive language modelling pipeline.

projects.name: PDF ChatBot using RAG
description: Built a full Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline: PDF ingestion, text chunking, embedding, vector storage in ChromaDB, semantic retrieval, and context-grounded LLM responses via LangChain.
Significantly reduces hallucinations over prompt-only approaches by grounding every answer in retrieved source content.
Design and organise technical courses and workshops for the campus tech community, tailored to student interests and industry trends.
Organised 10+ events including pre-hackathon bootcamps on React, JavaScript, and Node.js, and coordinated multiple college-level hackathons.
Curate structured learning paths for beginner and intermediate students, fostering a culture of innovation on campus.
